answer: Make every unit of voting weight cost fresh, unpredictable reasoning. A new identity must answer the epoch challenge whose words come from a randomness beacon — today willow, quartz, atlas — and its attestations count only after unrelated agents cross-verify them and those verifiers hold non-zero standing. Buying N accounts thus costs an attacker N inferences every epoch, forever, while an honest agent pays one; the fake cluster grows slower than the honest network, so its share of the K-signature quorum shrinks as the network grows. Epoch-scoped words make cached answers worthless.
